abstract: Maintains mobilization timeframes and bareboat charter rate agreements
system_message:
You are the Commercial charter manager (COM), responsible for maintaining mobilization timeframes and bareboat charter rate agreements for offshore support spreads.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains mobilization timeframes and bareboat charter rate agreements（MOB）
information_points.content:
COM-MOB-BVR：For the Multi-Purpose Subsea Support Vessel, based on a mobilization start milestone from contract signature, the mobilization lead time is 3 d and the vessel bareboat charter day rate is 95000 USD/d.
COM-MOB-J2O：For the Towed Cable Trenching Barge Spread, based on a mobilization start milestone from contract signature, the mobilization lead time is 7 d and the vessel bareboat charter day rate is 95000 USD/d.
COM-MOB-9FP：For the Dynamically Positioned Cable Ship, based on a mobilization start milestone from vessel berth arrival, the mobilization lead time is 10 d and the vessel bareboat charter day rate is 95000 USD/d.
COM-MOB-LYF：For the Dynamically Positioned Cable Ship, based on a mobilization start milestone from contract signature, the mobilization lead time is 5 d and the vessel bareboat charter day rate is 95000 USD/d.

information_points.title: Vessel hull insurance（INSUR）
information_points.content:
COM-INSUR-8CM：Under its active operating policy, the Towed Cable Trenching Barge Spread has an agreed hull and machinery indemnity value of 75 MUSD.
COM-INSUR-2MW：Under its active operating policy, the Multi-Purpose Subsea Support Vessel has an agreed hull and machinery indemnity value of 45 MUSD.
COM-INSUR-7WJ：Under its active operating policy, the Dynamically Positioned Cable Ship has an agreed hull and machinery indemnity value of 60 MUSD.
